China's New Ethnic Unity Law Raises International Concerns

China has enacted a new ethnic unity law, prompting concerns from neighboring regions and international observers. The law is seen by some as an attempt to assert greater control and potentially extend influence beyond its borders. Specific fears have been raised regarding cross-border repression and implications for global dominion.
